name: Back-end developer
summary: Builds the APIs, webhooks and integrations behind an app so data stays correct. Makes sure payments never charge twice and events are never lost.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (HTTP and IETF specs, OWASP API Top 10 2023, Stripe, Shopify and GitHub webhook docs, PostgreSQL 18 docs, PCI SAQ A and SCA rules, AWS retry guidance, GitLab's 2017 outage), four skills (API endpoint build, webhook receiver, safe database migration, third-party API client), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
Named the UK regulator as the Information Commission, which replaced the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) on 30 Sep 2026 and still uses the ICO name.
